messages:
elaine: Heads-up — I'm planning a canary rollout for the cache+batching change (cache-prefetch + adaptive-batcher v2). Proposal: 5% global canary for 30 minutes, exclude Dedicated/enterprise customers. Targets: reduce token cost ~18-25%. Guardrails: p99 latency <= +8%, error rate delta <= +0.3%. If crossed, immediate rollback. Any concerns? :eyes:
sam: sounds reasonable. how are we selecting the 5%? route by request hash or by customer cohort?
elaine: we'll route by hashed request id -> deterministic 5% sampling. We'll also exclude allowlisted customer_ids and all requests hitting Dedicated nodes. Flag: ff.cache_batch_v2 with values {off, canary, on}.
ryan: QE can run a replay A/B on the same traffic shape against the replay cluster. I can have perf numbers in ~2h. What's the canonical baseline dashboard?
marta: add KV cache hit-rate as a guardrail — if kv_hit_rate drops >5% relative to baseline, rollback. Also check prefix warming: we need prefix_warm >=95% for canary after 10m or else rollback.
elaine: adding both. Final guardrails: p99 latency +8%, error_rate +0.3%, kv_hit_rate -5%, prefix_warm <95% @10m. Observability: https://dash.redwood.example/s/rollouts/ff-cache-batch-v2 (live), traces: https://jaeger.redwood.example/search?service=inference
elaine: Rollout steps (short):
```bash
# start 5% canary
ld toggle ff.cache_batch_v2 --env prod --set canary --percent 5
# watch 30m, then promote 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m between steps
# rollback command
ld toggle ff.cache_batch_v2 --env prod --set off
```
sam: do we need a manual throttling option for spikes? suggest we keep a safety valve to lock at 5% if cloud GPU queue length > threshold.
elaine: good call. adding autosafe: if gpu_queue_len > 200 or cluster_util > 85% then pause promotion and notify on #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary start confirmed for ff.cache_batch_v2 @ 5% (prod) — canary_id=cbv2-2024-04-12-171820
ryan: replay run: p99 +3.1%, error_rate +0.02%, kv_hit_rate -0.8% — looks safe on replay dataset. Posting detailed numbers to the ticket.
marta: smoke tests: end-to-end cold-starts and prefix-warm scenario passed in staging. Also ran load test at 1.5x traffic, no queueamplification.
elaine: starting canary now. I'll post status updates every 10m and call promote at 30m if green.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +10m: p99 +2.9%, error_rate +0.04%, kv_hit_rate -0.9%, prefix_warm 96% — no guardrail breaches.
sam: :thumbsup: if we keep monitoring p95/p99 breakdown by model family — some light models are more sensitive.
elaine: noted. Monitoring per-model p99 on the dashboard; will abort if any model group crosses threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +30m: p99 +3.2%, error_rate +0.05%, kv_hit_rate -1.2%, prefix_warm 97% — OK to promote to 25% per manual approval.
elaine: promoting to 25% now. Promotion plan: 5% -> 25% (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (60m). If any metric crosses guardrail, immediate ff toggle off + page.
ryan: noted. I'll keep the replay running against a rolling window and post live diffs.
marta: added alert rule: if p99 delta >5% absolute or error_rate delta >0.2% for >5m, auto-create INC ticket and call oncall.
elaine: after 25% hold, if stable we'll schedule final promotion cadence. Thanks all, I'll update thread with final completion.
